notes.title: Q.1 (A) A1. Simple Activities (Any 4, 1 mark each)
notes.content: Topics include: Compound words, Pick out Infinitives/Gerund/Present Participles, Punctuate the sentence, Find hidden words, Make sentences from given phrase, Spot the error and rewrite, Identify the type of sentence, Word chain of nouns/verbs/adjectives, Form present/past participle where last letter is doubled, Arrange words in Alphabetical order.

notes.title: Example: Pick out the infinitive from the following sentence: He was asking to go for the concert.
Example: Identify the type of the sentence: Get out and wait in the yard.
Q.1 (A) A2. Medium Level Activities (Any 2, 2 marks each)
notes.content: Topics include: Homographs, Homophones, Direct-Indirect narration, Conversion of tenses, Change the voice, Word register.

notes.title: Example: The king said to the hermit, "Who are the people I most need?" (Rewrite the sentence in indirect speech.)
notes.content: The king asked the hermit who were the people he most needed.

notes.title: Q.1 (B) Challenging Activities (Any 1, 2 marks)
notes.content: Topics include: Usage of words in noun and verb form, Clause Analysis/Synthesis/Transformation, Degree of Comparison, Modal Auxiliaries, Use of two words in one meaningful sentence.

notes.title: Example: Make two different sentences to bring out the difference between homophones : wear, ware
notes.content: (a) I like to wear bright clothes. (b) The cooking ware we bought for the new house was expensive.

notes.title: Example: Identify the subordinate clause and state its type : When the train had gone, I found myself standing alone on the deserted platform.
notes.content: When the train had gone - Subordinate adverb clause of time.

flashcards.front: We must keep our promises. (Pick out the modal auxiliary and state its function)

flashcards.back: The base form of a verb preceded by 'to' (e.g., to go, to sleep).

quiz.question: Identify the type of sentence: 'Please close the door.'
quiz.explanation: An imperative sentence gives a command or makes a request.
